egress.terms: unmetered; byte path requires a signed token scraped from the landing page

tooling: POST /api/v1/upload -F file=@x -> JSON; then GET the /dl/<token>/<id>/<name> URL extracted from the HTML
limits_note: 100 MB/file; expires in 60 minutes (page rendered 'File expires in 59 minutes'). 10-upload burst all 200.
reliability_note: Textbook trap candidate: the API's own returned URL does NOT serve bytes. You must make a second request, scrape a timestamp+hash-signed /dl/ URL, and use that — and the signature expires. Also the API host did not resolve on this machine's DNS (0.0.0.0 answer); needed --resolve. Many resolvers/ISPs sinkhole it.
